title: Ray touching only a wall corner
description: A single explicit sight ray meets a wall at one corner and leaves again.
basis: U13: grazing an edge or corner does not block; U77
ruling: The middle ray from (4,12) to (10,18) touches the wall only at its corner (6,14), so it is not blocked; the right-hand column passes through the wall: Partial, and the wall does not touch the target, so no cover. (Before L2: one fixed ray, Full 1/1.)
